picks.headline: AWS Automates Bedrock Private Pricing Offer Distribution Across Organizations
picks.why: It allows enterprise platform teams to systematically deploy and govern negotiated Bedrock model pricing across multi-account AWS environments.
picks.title: Manage private pricing offers for Amazon Bedrock with managed entitlements

picks.headline: Cold-Boot Physical Capture Bypasses Weight Rotation in Edge Image Classifiers
picks.why: It proves that streaming multi-exit model weights into volatile edge memory fails to prevent physical model theft by sophisticated adversaries.
picks.title: When Rotation Bounds Nothing: Streaming Image Classifiers to Field Nodes Under Physical Capture

picks.headline: LMCache Cuts Long-Context Remote KV Cache Prefill Latency to Sub-Second
picks.why: It resolves critical remote KV cache bottlenecks in context-parallel prefill, dropping 16k-token p99 latency from 83s to 0.67s on FP8 GLM-5.3.
picks.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill

picks.headline: Search-Augmented LLMs Systematically Ignore Retrieved Context for Parametric Memory
picks.why: It exposes a critical failure mode in RAG systems where models fall back to outdated parametric knowledge despite relevant evidence in context.
picks.title: Retrieved but Not Read: Understanding Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail to Use Available Evidence

papers.headline: Sparse Autoencoders Require Vastly More Data for Feature Reproducibility Than Functionality
papers.why: The authors show that functional performance metrics converge much faster than true feature stability, meaning standard SAE evaluations may mask poor interpretability.
papers.title: Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility

papers.headline: Open Midtraining Recipe Primes Base Models for Agentic Post-Training
papers.why: It provides a reproducible recipe for 256K context midtraining on software data and execution traces to improve downstream agentic performance.
papers.title: Priming Base Models for Agentic Post-Training: An Open Midtraining Recipe

papers.headline: Unembedding Dynamics Reveal Output Layer Lags Hidden States in LLM Pretraining
papers.why: It introduces a framework to track how unembedding layers evolve relative to internal representations during language model pretraining.
papers.title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
